measurand: equivalent whole-layer calibration mass in g
loading_geometry: shared with the source multi-point sweep

source.endpoint_aggregation: per-cell median per 200-frame capture, then median across captures at each load

calibration.invalid_response_policy: NaN when response_span <= 0; retain QC flags
calibration.outside_endpoint_policy: clip controlled outputs; separately log out-of-range ADC

zero_load.aggregation: per-cell median per 200-frame capture, then median across captures at this load

full_load.aggregation: per-cell median per 200-frame capture, then median across captures at this load
